content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Ento./26/2376-2449 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CCS HAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Essential: Post Graduate Degree in Entomology with 55% marks and NET/GATE. Desirable: Candidates with research experience in the Entomology field. Experience: Desirable: research experience in the Entomology field Age limit: Maximum 35 years (on the last date of submission of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, PH 5 years, In-service candidates of agricultural universities Up to 45 years Other conditions: Must sign a declaration of secrecy and Non-Disclosure agreement before reporting Must execute an agreement on a Non-judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- before joining Medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the University required at the time of joining Desirable: Candidates with research experience in the Entomology field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration of post up to 31st March, 2027 and extendable upto duration of the project Appointment co-terminus with the project Maximum duration of engagement is 2 years / duration of research project whichever is earlier Not a regular employee; no CPF/GPF or other benefits of regular employees Selected candidate may leave after one month notice in writing to the University Services liable to be terminated on non-release of funds by the Funding agency

content_sections.text: Interview Interview on 20.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar No separate letter for interview will be issued No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Completed application proforma Attested copies of certificates of qualifications (marks / OGPA / CGPA) Experience certificates Certificates of awards / rank, if any Copy of proof of any other qualifications relevant to the post Original certificates and certified true copies at the interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application proforma attached to the notification. Attach attested copies of certificates of qualifications, experience, awards and other relevant qualifications as the proforma asks. Send the complete application so that it is received in the office of the Head (Entomology), Department of Entomology, CCS HAU, Hisar by 19.11.2026 up to 4.00 PM. Appear for the interview on 20.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar with original certificates.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No application received after 19.11.2026 upto 4.00 PM will be entertained for any reason Selected candidate must report for duty within 10 days of issue of appointment order, failing which appointment will be treated as cancelled May be deputed on tour by the HOD/PI and entitled to conveyance charges/DA equal to Grade-IV employees under CCS HAU TA rules No adjustment on any other university post after the project ends

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma attached to the notification (pages 3 and 4)) and send it to Office of the Head (Entomology), Department of Entomology, CCS HAU, Hisar, to reach by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (on the last date of submission of application). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, PH 5 years, In-service candidates of agricultural universities Up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37000 (fixed/Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: Post Graduate Degree in Entomology with 55% marks and NET/GATE. Desirable: Candidates with research experience in the Entomology field.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must sign a declaration of secrecy and Non-Disclosure agreement before reporting. Must execute an agreement on a Non-judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- before joining. Medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the University required at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 20.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for interview will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration of post up to 31st March, 2027 and extendable upto duration of the project. Appointment co-terminus with the project. Maximum duration of engagement is 2 years / duration of research project whichever is earlier.

faq.answer: Department of Entomology, CCS HAU, Hisar.
